title: What size icons do you use for retro RPG s?

posts.author: MechPen
posts.body:
The easiest way to make a retro styled RPG in RPG Maker MV/MZ is to scale up the graphics 3x. 16x16 tiles scale up to 48x48 tiles and work very well with the default asset standards. Most other assets work fine with this workflow, except for icons.
The standard icon size is 32x32 which isn't divisible by 3. Leaving a one pixel border would work but then icon assets are 10x10 which are rarely produced and don't look the best with the standard font size of 12-16 pixels. 8x8 icons are produced but have a similar issue. 16x16 icons are widely produced but would require the text be on the larger size and would need a plug-in to be loaded into the engine at 48x48.
Has anyone made a retro-styled RPG? How did you handle your icons? I'd love to know.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
You can do some mock-ups to see the effect.
16x16 doesn't look too big comparing to the font size which is 12.  But line height need to be changed to fit them in.
The only problem is you have to write a plugin for MV. But since your game is already heavily modded it is not really a problem.
